Choosing a wedding band depends on personal style, daily comfort, and how it pairs with an engagement ring.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/types-of-wedding-rings/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0PAjpU3zFiU)

### Popular Wedding Band Styles

- **Classic Plain Bands:** Smooth, polished metal rings in yellow gold, white gold, rose gold, or platinum that offer timeless elegance.[[1]](https://mirojewelers.com/blogs/our-blogs/13-types-of-wedding-bands-a-complete-guide)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/types-of-wedding-rings/)
- **Eternity and Half-Eternity Bands:** Rings featuring a continuous or half-row of sparkling diamonds or simulated gemstones. You can learn more about these designs in this [Guide to Wedding Band Styles](https://www.brides.com/story/guide-to-popular-wedding-band-style-hers).[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12207835513053600718,catalogid:10013920651589759834,gpcid:14941636110283717372,mid:576462888237704648&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15217023334237019100,catalogid:2480171384724726305,gpcid:8470398515043144013,mid:576462901802026905&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.brides.com/story/guide-to-popular-wedding-band-style-hers)
- **Textured and Hammered Bands:** Rings with a hand-hammered, brushed, or satin finish that add a rugged or modern, low-shine look.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/types-of-wedding-rings/)
- **Contoured and Curved Bands:** Shaped with a slight curve or "V" dip to fit snugly against a distinct engagement ring center stone.[[1]](https://www.reisnichols.com/blogs/news/wedding-band-101)
- **Milgrain and Vintage-Inspired:** Detailed with tiny raised metal beads or intricate engravings for an antique aesthetic.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/types-of-wedding-rings/)

### Common Metals

- **Precious Metals:** Yellow, white, and rose gold (typically 14k or 18k) along with naturally strong platinum.[[1]](https://www.sarahojewelry.com/articles/guide-to-mens-wedding-band-styles)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/XXxP7qCFx-w)[[3]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/types-of-wedding-rings/)
- **Alternative Metals:** Durable, budget-friendly options like tungsten, titanium, and cobalt.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/types-of-wedding-rings/)

If you'd like to narrow down your options, let me know:

- Who the ring is for (**men's, women's, or matching**)
- Are you pairing it with an **engagement ring**?
- What **metal or budget** do you prefer?
